title: Previous Taller Tree
statement: Trees stand in a row. For each tree, return the height of the nearest tree to its left that is strictly taller, or −1 if there is none.

keyPoints: Keep heights that strictly decrease from bottom to top
Pop while the top is <= the current height
The top (if any) is the answer; push the current height
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Scan left from each tree: O(n²)

hints: Which trees to the left can still be someone's answer later?
Only trees that are taller than everything after them. Shorter or equal ones are hidden.
Keep a stack with strictly decreasing heights; pop while top <= current, then read the top.
